ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: Reverts #3952: poll_loop's yield condition no longer considers wants_write_again, so the loop yields whenever wants_read_again is false. This re-removes the guard that the prior fix added to prevent a rare missed write-side wakeup/deadlock when body_rx still has data but no read is expected. The dedicated ready_stream test and its Cargo.toml entry are also deleted.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title: 'Revert "fix(http1): fix rare missed write wakeup on connections (#3952)"'. Body: 'This reverts commit 2377b893... Reports in #3976 suggest this is consuming a lot of CPU.' The revert intentionally re-introduces the prior wakeup behavior to address a CPU regression, accepting the original rare-missed-wakeup risk. The deleted inline comment explicitly warned 'would lead to a deadlock if we also don't expect reads.'
